lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four visible horizontal rows posterior to the gill/pectoral region. Centroids exhibit uniform spacing with approximately 5 to 7 distinct nodes per row within the visible frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges run longitudinally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the upper edge and defined shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A single high-luminance blob is visible at the anterior base of the first dorsal fin's silhouette. The remainder of the fin surface shows lower-intensity mottled patterning without clearly defined, discrete circular blobs.
